Methodology and Interpretation (Alpha/Beta Power)

The values in the table represent the percentage change in power of the Loaded (LD) vs. Spontaneous (VS) difference, relative to a VS baseline period (-2.0s to -1.5s).

% Change = 100 * ( (Power_LD_active - Power_VS_active) / Power_VS_baseline )

A negative value (e.g., -40%) indicates power suppression (desynchronization). A positive value indicates power increase (synchronization).

The asterisk (*) indicates a statistically significant difference (p < 0.05) of that activity compared to its own baseline (i.e., significantly different from zero).
